text.p: Optical Cable Corp said on Monday it forecast 1996 earnings would be $0.19 per share on sales of $45.2 million and 1997 earnings would be $0.31 per share on sales of $62.7 million.

The company, in announcing its three year sales and earnings projections, also said it expected 1998 earnings of $0.45 per share on sales of $91.5 million and 1999 earnings of $0.69 per share on $136.8 million in sales.
The company said the data were based on about 38.7 million shares outstanding.
There were no First Call mean earnings estimates for the company.
Optical Cable also said sales estimates were based on existing market segments and not on any new future market penetrations.
